description: A dropdown for selecting a single value from a list of options. Use Select.Combobox for searchable/filterable selection, and Select.Multi or Select.Combobox.Multiple for multi-value selection.
instructions: Use Select for simple single-value selection. Use Select.Combobox when users need to search or filter the options list. Use Select.Multi or Select.Combobox.Multiple for multi-value selection. Group options with Select.Group. Use Select.Slot to add icons to items. Use Dropdown instead when items trigger actions rather than selecting a value. Use indeterminateValues on Select.Multi or Select.Combobox.Multiple when editing several records at once and an option applies to some of them but not all. Those options render a dash instead of a checkmark and the trigger gains a '2 mixed' badge next to the selection badges. Indeterminate values are purely visual and are never reported by onSelect. Toggling an indeterminate item: clicking it sets it to selected and it is reported in the array passed to onSelect. Clicking it again removes the selected state and it is omitted from the array passed to onSelect. Important: the consumer must remove the value from indeterminateValues themselves once it has been selected, otherwise it shows as indeterminate instead of unselected after being deselected.
name: Select
